sections.content: SVG is markup for vector graphics — scalable, styleable with CSS, scriptable. Canvas is a bitmap drawing surface for pixels — charts, games, image processing.
Use SVG for icons/logos/diagrams (crisp at any size), canvas for dynamic pixel work. Both live inside HTML pages natively.
Key points: SVG elements are DOM nodes (styleable/animatable), canvas needs JS to draw, and prefer CSS/SVG animations over canvas for UI effects.

sections.codeExample:
<svg width="100" height="100">
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="blue"/>
</svg>
<canvas id="game" width="300" height="150"></canvas>
